fact: On 28 April 2024 the manager of the government data and cloud computing centre said more than 30 international computing companies were used to build the centre, designed and implemented by Egyptian cadres from companies and state digital officials.
title: مدير "البيانات": استعنا بأكثر من 30 شركة عالمية متخصصة فى الحوسبة لتأسيس المركز
